text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I think my cleat is loose.
Could you give me a second
to check it quickly, please?
choice_data_list: You're working so hard on your English studies... You're not overdoing it, are you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't worry.
To reach such a big goal as racing overseas,
we have to build things up little by little!
We want to do something for Loves Only You as she works hard toward her overseas expansion... That has been the dilemma for myself and the communications team lately.
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can do...?
I wonder if there's anything I can do...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Are you troubled, Bridge-san?
I bet this is about Love-chan, isn't it~?"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"I know, right? Love-chan's studying English,
working hard on manners, trends, making friends—
she does it all so flawlessly!"
It seemed she was another person who wanted to support Loves Only You.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"‘Cheer them up with support illustrations?
Offer healing with relaxing aromatherapy?
Hmm, all of those feel kind of meh!’"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"To help Love-chan win races overseas...
I wonder what kind of thing I can give her~..."
choice_data_list: In order to win... that's it!

text_block_list.text: How about a livestream project where we invite students with overseas experience to train together with us?!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
“――――!! Yeah! I think that sounds great...!
Maru-chan wants in on that project too...!”

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "‘Maru-chan will be the best training partner for Love-chan――a buddy who can aim for the world together!’"

Once the project was greenlit, it was a whirlwind of days.
The comms team handled reserving training facilities,
while I ran around negotiating guest appearances.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: A training livestream off-campus gathering those with overseas experience... That sounds wonderful. Please allow me to help.

Students with stellar track records from all over the world
readily agreed to appear. Just one more...
Time to negotiate with a big name...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. It is indeed a grand and imposing plan, on paper.
However, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Are you serious?
Challenging overseas is easy to talk about, but—
it's not going to be that simple.

A wave of tension runs through me beneath her stern, discerning gaze.
However... I am absolutely certain that
Loves Only You can win abroad.
choice_data_list: I'm fully determined to let you claim the victory.
I'm fully determined to let you claim the victory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
..................I see.
I understand completely. I shall consider it favorably.

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Bridge really negotiated hard..."
"I've already picked out the venues where streaming is allowed!"
"Let's pick the very best one!" "Can't wait~"
choice_data_list: Let's give Loves the best day ever!

text_block_list.text: —The day of the event.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A surprise plan... right here?
What are you gonna do, what are you gonna do~?
choice_data_list: It's a special training session—with them!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo! Calling all globetrotters! ♡
We're gonna help Loves with
her overseas challenge! ♡♡♡

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I was deeply moved by the Trainer's passion
and meticulously detailed proposal.
I shall impart all the knowledge at my disposal to you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh... What...?
Does that mean... Trainer-kun, you were the one who made the offer...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh... What...?
Does that mean... Trainer-chan, you were the one who made the offer...?

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"And we're the ones who arranged the facility!"
"We've reserved it for the whole day~!!"
"Train to your heart's content~!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —All of this, just for me...
choice_data_list: And then, there's one more person—

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "It's Maru-chan, your special guest! I've powered up like crazy so I can aim for overseas races alongside Love-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"With this, we can totally hone our skills together!
...Will you let me do my best with you, Love-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
――...Yeah. Mmh... yeah!!
Let's do our best together, Maru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
1, 2, 1, 2――maintain your core pressure.
One more set, then onto the barbell.
Let's build up that body properly.

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Keep it up~! That's the spirit~~!!"
"Whoa~~ that workload looks insane!"
"Go Loves! Fight, Loves!"

text_block_list.name: Loves & Marche
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*...!
N-Not yet... not yet...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah...!
Together, we can do even better, right...!!

After a full day of rigorous training with Cesario and the others... evening arrived in the blink of an eye. After having the four with overseas experience head back to the dorms first, I took a breather, when—

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Love-chan, great job today~!
How did everything go?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I learned soooo much!
It gave me a much clearer picture of racing overseas.
And above all—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I felt everyone's love.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
There's so much you need to deliver love to the world, isn't there?
Manners, culture, language...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I still have to work much harder
to master it. But—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's love is an indispensable piece too.
I was able to truly appreciate that once again."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. I know I'm going to win my overseas races.
—After all, I'm brimming with everyone's love!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! I want to review what we just learned,
so how about we run a little more?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Let's go...!

Loves Only You's running accelerates more and more.
Powerfully, charging toward the world—!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I've still got to give it my all!
...Would it be all right if I went for a little more of a run?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's where I have to step in as your Trainer and stop you!

text_block_list.text:
The road to the world stage is still a long one.
Take it one step at a time, without rushing. Filled with love as she is,
she is sure to spread her wings and soar.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! Next up is mental training!
Everyone, pretend I'm in an overseas race and
create an "away-game atmosphere" for me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Us?!"
"You mean we gotta pretend to not care about Loves?!"
"Ugh, talk about an unexpected form of torture..."

"With everyone's love and support pushing Loves Only You forward...
I want to take flight together. To the world!"
